user.title: Import Energy dashboard

data_description.port: TCP port of the bridge's own HomeKit server. Must differ from the HomeKit Bridge integration.
data_description.update_interval: Minimum seconds between HomeKit notifications per value (1-300).

node.title: Power source for {node_name}
node.description:
Node {position} of {count}: **{node_name}** ({role}), energy meter `{energy_entity}`.

Choose the sensor that reports live power in W or kW. Positive means: Grid = importing, Battery = discharging, Solar/Device = producing/consuming. Enable "Inverted" if your sensor uses the opposite sign.

home.title: Home consumption (optional)
home.description: If Home Assistant has a real sensor for total home consumption, select it here. Leave both fields empty and Controller for HomeKit derives home consumption from grid, solar and battery.

error.confirm_required: Please confirm the import to continue.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single Controller Energy Bridge is allowed.
